client: Fernwood Pantry
client_industry: e-commerce
start: 2025-07
end: 2025-10
engagement: hourly
stack:

- NestJS

The review is from: Fernwood Pantry
Rating: 5.0 out of 5

- 2 to 5 sentences in the voice of a busy client, not a marketer.

text: Tobias was easy to work with and kept communication clear throughout the project, which made a pretty technical backend migration feel straightforward for our team. He stayed responsive, explained tradeoffs well, and kept us updated as we moved 6.5k subscribers off our legacy setup and onto Stripe Billing. The retry flow he built helped recover 31% of failed payments, and the whole engagement ran smoothly from our side.
